meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 用户要求后，Claude会扫描未引用的文件、导出和符号，逐个检查是否真的没人引用；确认后按文件分组，交给多个后台代理同时删除，并分别独立提交。它自己不直接改代码；若没有发现无用代码，就报告找不到。
howto.when: 当用户要求清理未使用代码，或提到“remove dead code”“cleanup”等触发词时进入。默认扫描整个项目；也可指定文件、目录或符号来缩小范围。

say.text: 清理项目里没用的代码
say.note: 先扫描并逐项验证，确认后并行删除并提交。

say.text: 只清理 src/hooks 目录下没人用到的代码
say.note: 扫描范围会限定在该目录。

say.text: 把 src/utils.ts 里没人引用的常量删掉并提交
say.note: 会仅针对这个文件做检查。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude scans unused files/exports/symbols, verifies each with reference lookup, batches by file, and dispatches parallel agents to remove and commit atomically. It never edits code itself; if none found it reports no dead code found.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests to clean unused code or by phrases like 'remove dead code' or 'cleanup'. Default scope is the whole project; can be narrowed to a file, directory, or symbol.

say_en.text: Clean up all unused code in this project.
say_en.note: Scans, verifies, then removes and commits in parallel.

say_en.text: Only clean unused code under the src/hooks directory.
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory.

say_en.text: Remove unreferenced constants from src/utils.ts and commit.
say_en.note: Restricts scanning to that single file.
